product.name: Commercial Trading Services
product.description: Services involving the buying and selling of goods for commercial purposes across various sectors.

product.name: Hospitality Services
product.description: Provision of services related to accommodation, food, and guest management for hospitality businesses.

product.name: Events Services
product.description: Planning and management of events including coordination, logistics, and execution for various occasions.

product.name: Facilities Management (FM) Services
product.description: Management and maintenance of buildings and facilities to ensure operational functionality and safety.

product.name: Freight Services
product.description: Transportation and logistics services for the movement of goods by land, sea, or air.
